plan.title: Single-stage forward auction rejects negative quantity

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case configuration.
Set the event type to Auction and configure the forward auction screen.
Provide the mandatory event title so the validation test is complete apart from the intentionally invalid quantity.
Apply the first available auction pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and enter the invalid negative quantity in the first row.
Assert that Procol immediately refuses the negative quantity with a quantity-related validation error.
